name: Deploy Lexical Search Worker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'services/lexical-search-worker/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build lexical-search-worker
        run: npm run build --workspace=lexical-search-worker

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          workingDirectory: services/lexical-search-worker
          command: deploy

      - name: Sync lexical data to worker
        run: |
          npm run sync --workspace=lexical-search-worker
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          WORKER_URL: ${{ secrets.WORKER_URL }}

  test:
    needs: deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lexical-search-worker tests
        run: npm run test --workspace=lexical-search-worker

      - name: Run lexical-search-worker typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck --workspace=lexical-search-worker

      - name: Run lexical-search-worker lint
        run: npm run lint --workspace=lexical-search-worker

      - name: Run semantic search tests
        run: npm exec --workspace=kentcdodds.com vitest run app/utils/__tests__/semantic-search.server.test.ts

      - name: Run kentcdodds.com typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck --workspace=kentcdodds.com

      - name: Run kentcdodds.com lint
        run: npm run lint --workspace=kentcdodds.com

      - name: Verify local dev setup
        run: |
          curl http://127.0.0.1:3002/search?q=shallow%20rendering
